title: Remembering a Historical Figure: sokan ... tekintik, emléket állít

sections.title: Commemorative Phrases in Hungarian
sections.content: To describe how a historical figure is remembered, Hungarian uses commemorative phrases: *sokan ... jelképének tekintik* (many regard ... as the symbol of ...), *emléket állít* (sets up a memorial to), *tisztelet övezi* (is surrounded by respect).

items.spanish: Sokan a nemzeti függetlenség jelképének tekintik Rákóczit.
items.english: Many regard Rákóczi as the symbol of national independence.

items.spanish: Mikes Kelemen a Törökországi levelekben emléket állított a bujdosóknak.
items.english: In the Letters from Turkey, Kelemen Mikes set up a memorial to the exiles.
